code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter, defaultdict
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    positions = defaultdict(list)
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        for c, value in enumerate(row):
            if value != background:
                positions[value].append((r, c))
    for color, pts in positions.items():
        for i, (r1, c1) in enumerate(pts):
            for r2, c2 in pts[i + 1:]:
                dr, dc = r2-r1, c2-c1
                if abs(dr) != 1 or abs(dc) != 1:
                    continue
                others = [p for p in (p for ps in positions.values() for p in ps)
                          if p != (r1, c1) and p != (r2, c2)]
                if not others:
                    continue
                mr, mc = (r1+r2)/2, (c1+c2)/2
                vr = sum(r for r, c in others)/len(others) - mr
                vc = sum(c for r, c in others)/len(others) - mc
                dot = dr*vr + dc*vc
                if dot > 0:
                    sr, sc, step_r, step_c = r1, c1, -dr, -dc
                else:
                    sr, sc, step_r, step_c = r2, c2, dr, dc
                r, c = sr+step_r, sc+step_c
                while 0 <= r < h and 0 <= c < w:
                    if out[r][c] == background:
                        out[r][c] = color
                    r += step_r
                    c += step_c
    return out
'''
